description: This file defines a repository class for managing team billing and proration data, including methods for retrieving, updating, and creating billing information related to teams and organizations, with a focus on monthly and annual billing periods.

classes.name: MonthlyProrationTeamRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling team billing data, including retrieval, updates, and creation of billing records, as well as extracting billing info from metadata.

methods.name: getTeamWithBilling
methods.description: Fetches team details along with billing info, either from team records or metadata.

methods.name: getAnnualTeamsWithSeatChanges
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of teams with annual billing and seat changes for a given month.

methods.name: updateBillingInfo
methods.description: Updates billing information for a team or organization.

methods.name: updatePaidSeats
methods.description: Updates the number of paid seats for a team or organization.

methods.name: getTeamMemberCount
methods.description: Returns the member count for a specific team.

methods.name: createOrganizationBilling
methods.description: Creates a new billing record for an organization.

methods.name: createTeamBilling
methods.description: Creates a new billing record for a team.

methods.name: extractBillingFromMetadata
methods.description: Parses billing info from team metadata.
